## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -11.88%) BELOW TREND point to risk-on tilt, but leadership is concentrated in XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND so market breadth warrants caution.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Equities vs bonds rising: SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY) ↑ rising. Fear falling: VXX (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -11.88%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit signal mixed: HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -0.30%) RECOVERY.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive. UUP (Dollar proxy) (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -0.25%) NEUTRAL and yield curve modest steepening with Yield Curve metric (1W: +0.07% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY; overall conditions neither aggressively tightening nor easing.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech-led narrow rally: XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND showing strong momentum while XLE (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND lag; style mixed — growth leadership but limited breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US strong but EM catching up: SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +10.18%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.31%) ABOVE TREND show pockets of international strength despite Europe metrics lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation active: IBIT (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +12.32%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND indicate risk-on flows, but narrow sector breadth tempers enthusiasm.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals and precious metals strength: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +6.12%) ABOVE TREND, with GLD (1W: +1.89% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Divergent price action with weakness near-term: XLE (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +11.77%) CORRECTION and UGA (1W: -3.65% | 1M: +18.78%) CORRECTION — watch for further dispersion.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR DIVERGENCE present: XLF (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +0.86%) RECOVERY, TLT (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY and HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION show conflicting 1W vs 1M signals — suppress strong Risk-On posture.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective exposure to technology/momentum ETFs such as XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND while reducing exposure to weak energy/utilities like XLE (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND; monitor credit (HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION) and breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +32.93%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, XLU (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +6.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +11.77%) CORRECTION, XLE (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -11.88%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -0.30%) RECOVERY — monitor HYG/LQD ~0.80 for credit stress. XLK/XLF dispersion (XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +0.86%) RECOVERY) — watch ratio around 2.0 for style pivot.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive — narrow market leadership despite risk-on signals. XLK (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; key risk is major divergence across credit and cyclical ETFs (XLF (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +0.86%) RECOVERY; HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION) — monitor breadth and credit closely.
